Collapsed Experiment

This module provides functionality to run experiments that test agent decision-making with and without decision support systems, using the single-prediction collapsed agent model for k-dimensional covariates.

This is the multivariate counterpart of experiment.py. The data-generating process and the prediction model are multivariate, the prediction model is fitted with an intercept, and the agent’s belief update uses the collapsed likelihood, which marginalizes the structural coefficient vectors N_b and N_d analytically.

The script takes three command line parameters where the first one is the key in agent_priors to modify, the second one what value agent_priors[key] should take, and the third one what value every coordinate of X_o should take.

Example:

python experiment_collapsed.py N_E_mu -20 72

This would set the value of the prior distribution of N_E to -20 and use 72 as the value of every feature of the observed patient.

Notes: The collapsed agent model marginalizes N_b and N_d analytically. For the agent-side predictive summaries and expected do(A) outcomes, the marginalized coefficient vectors are reconstructed when needed: from their priors for prior predictive sampling, and from their conditional Gaussian given (N_E, R, T, the population-level parameters, and pred_o) for posterior predictive sampling. The output schema is therefore identical to experiment.py, with no padded fields.

experiment_collapsed.main(X_o, agent_priors, modified_prior, A1_treatment=20, A0_treatment=10, n_covariates=2, plate_size=1000, draws=1000, scm_noise_parameters={'N_E': 1.0, 'N_b': -0.05, 'N_d': 0.0625, 'alpha_mu_A': 2.0, 'alpha_mu_X': 80.0, 'alpha_mu_Y': 12.0, 'alpha_sigma_A': 1.0, 'alpha_sigma_X': 10.0, 'alpha_sigma_Y': 0.1, 'n_covariates': 2}, parameter_descriptions={'agent_priors': 'Default', 'scm_constants': 'Default', 'scm_noise_parameters': 'Default'}, rng=4)[source]
Parameters:

  • X_o (np.array) – Feature vector of the observed patient (length k).

  • agent_priors (dict) – Dictionary with all values that encodes the agent’s prior beliefs.

  • modified_prior (dict) – Information about which prior was changed and how much.

  • A1_treatment (float) – Value of treatment 1.

  • A0_treatment (float) – Value of treatment 0.

  • n_covariates (int) – Number of covariates k.

  • plate_size (int) – Size of plate / number or observations to generate for regression model. Measure of “evidence” for predictions from decision support model.

  • draws (int) – Size of sample to generate in sampling events.

  • scm_noise_parameters (dict) – Dict with keys needed in MultivariateSCM-class.

  • rng (int or rng) – Seed or rng for reproducibility.
